title: Software update
description: Knovum checks after startup and every six hours. Downloads and installation require your confirmation.

action.failed: The update action could not complete. Review the update status and try again.

install.blocked: Finish or cancel running background tasks before restarting.
install.title: Preparing to restart Knovum
install.description: Saving your changes and installing the verified update. Do not close the application.

status.disabled: Updates are not enabled in this build.
status.idle: Ready to check the release channel.
status.available: Review the release notes, then download the signed update.
status.ready: Downloaded and verified. Restart when you are ready.

failure.check: Could not check the release channel. Check your connection and try again.
failure.download: The download failed. Check your connection and available storage, then check again.
failure.signature: The update signature is invalid. Installation was refused. Check again after the publisher fixes the release.
failure.install: Installation failed. Your changes were saved. Check permissions and storage before checking again.
